members.name: Prof. Michiel Spapé
members.bio: Associate Professor, Centre for Cognitive and Brain Sciences & Faculty of Science and Technology, University of Macau. PhD in Psychology, Leiden University; previously University of Nottingham, Helsinki Institute for Information Technology, Liverpool Hope University, and University of Helsinki. Associate editor of Psychological Research and Frontiers in Psychology: Cognition.
members.interests: Consciousness & cognition · Perception & action · Emotion & social cognition · Human–computer interaction

members.name: Dr. Imtiaj Ahmed
members.bio: Postdoctoral researcher. PhD in Computer Science, University of Helsinki (2024) — dissertation “Haptic interaction with affective agents in virtual reality”, supervised by Prof. Giulio Jacucci and Prof. Michiel Spapé. Works on haptic technologies, affective virtual agents and physiological sensing in VR.
members.interests: Haptics · Affective virtual agents · VR · Physiological sensing

members.name: Aotong Li (Allie)
members.bio: PhD student, Centre for Cognitive and Brain Sciences & Department of Computer and Information Science, University of Macau. First author of “BrainPrompting” (Scientific Reports, 2026) on reconstructing facial memory through brain-based generative AI interaction.
